h1: Amazon PPC management, built on your margins
overview: Pay-per-click needs steady attention. We audit your Amazon campaigns, research keywords, group them into clean campaigns, set bids from your margins and cut wasted spend with negative keywords. Over the sprint we tune bids and budgets, review search term reports and send a plain summary. We follow Amazon Ads policies, and we cannot promise a set cost of sales or revenue.

pkgs.blurb: An audit of your campaigns, with the biggest wastes fixed.
A rebuilt structure with keyword research and one tuning round.
Two tuning rounds across your range, with a report and next plan.
list: Two bid and budget tuning rounds

faq: How is this different from Amazon Ads setup?
Amazon Ads is a first setup with one or two reviews. PPC management goes deeper: keyword research, a rebuilt campaign structure and tuning rounds, aimed at accounts already spending money on ads.
What do you need to start?
Reporting and campaign access in Amazon Ads, your product costs or target margin, and a list of the products you most want to push. Spend data from the last 60 days helps us.
We cannot name a number honestly. It depends on your price, margin, reviews and competition. We set a target together, work toward it step by step and show real figures.
Do you bid on competitor brands?
Only where Amazon allows it. We never use trademarked names in listing copy, and any competitor targeting is limited to the product targeting that Amazon Ads offers, only with your approval.
